topics.definition: A function is a block of code that performs a specific task.
topics.example: int add(int a,int b){ return a+b; }

topics.definition: A function declaration tells the compiler about the function before it is used.
A function definition contains the actual implementation.
topics.syntax: int add(int a,int b){ return a+b; }
tips: Each function should perform one task.

topics.definition: A function call executes a function.
Parameters receive values while arguments are the actual values passed.
tips: Parameter types should match argument types.

topics.definition: The return statement sends a value back to the calling function.
tips: void functions do not return a value.

topics.definition: Recursion is when a function calls itself.
Storage classes define scope, lifetime and visibility of variables.
tips: Understand static and extern well for exams.
